title: Heavenly Fate Lock Key
next_chapter_hook: "When Chen Ji finally pieced together the complete picture of the Holy Sect's plan, his fingertips halted at the edge of that blurry prophetic vision—if rescuing Chen Nian also freed an existence that even the Heavenly Eye feared, how should he choose?"

text.content:
"When Chen Ji saw the coordinates marked on that yellowed blueprint, his pupils contracted sharply—that location was precisely the entrance to the Forbidden Grounds he had been investigating for three entire years.

There was a faint scent of ink at the blueprint's edge, and Chen Ji recognized this type of ink—the ink he had seen in the Chen family mansion during his childhood, reserved exclusively for elders who managed confidential documents. His fingers trembled slightly as he flipped the blueprint over, and printed on the back in small characters were the words: 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the Shackle of the Heavenly Eye, the Holy Sect's Century-Long Grand Plan.'

He abruptly raised his head, gazing at the Tianji Record Fragment hovering beside him. The prophetic vision on it was twisting violently, as if some force was interfering—blurring, flickering, fragmenting. And the source of that interference, he faintly sensed a familiar aura.

It was Chen Nian. His sister, the aura he had been separated from for years."

dialogue.content:
"You saw it.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly materialized from the fragment, his voice more solemn than usual: Chen Nian is not merely your sister, she is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key—the key specifically used to seal the Heavenly Eye's power. The Holy Sect has spent a century searching for infants with special bloodlines, cultivating them—and your sister is the most successful of them all.

His tone paused: But what they don't know is that once this key is unlocked, what is sealed and what is released might be the same thing."

text.content:
"Chen Ji's hand slowly lowered from the blueprint, his knuckles white from force.

He remembered that night ten years ago—the night the Chen family was destroyed, when he was rescued from the raging flames while Chen Nian was abducted. He had always believed it was the work of the Demonic Path, always believed his sister was a victim.

But what if from the very beginning, the Chen family was the Holy Sect's testing ground? What if both he and Chen Nian were chosen pieces on a chessboard?

His gaze gradually chilled, but something deep within him churned violently. Ten years—he thought he was playing a grand game, but from the start, he too was a piece on the board.

'Continue.' His voice was terrifyingly calm. 'I want to know how the Holy Sect intends to use her.'"

dialogue.content:
"The Holy Sect plans to use the Heavenly Fate Lock Key as a medium on the day the Forbidden Grounds opens, forcibly prying open the seal of the Heavenly Eye.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flickered: They intend to release the Heavenly Eye's full power, then use some forbidden technique to appropriate it for themselves. And your sister's bloodline happens to suppress the Heavenly Eye's corrosion of mortal consciousness—in other words, she is their cage for taming a beast.

'But she is also a human being.' Chen Ji's voice was soft, but Mo Xiansheng detected the killing intent within it.

I know. Mo Xiansheng sighed: This is also why the Tianji Record chose you—you are the only person who might simultaneously save her and prevent all this."

text.content:
"Chen Ji looked at the Tianji Record Fragment again, this time attempting to actively trace Chen Nian's aura.

The prophetic vision formed with difficulty—a dark underground palace, ancient symbols carved into the walls. At the center of the vision, a young girl was suspended by chains in mid-air, surrounded by dozens of black-robed cultivators. They were chanting some eerie incantation, and the air was filled with suffocating oppression.

Chen Nian was there. Her face was much thinner than in his memories, her eyes tightly closed, and there was a faint silver mark on her forehead.

Chen Ji's fists slowly clenched. He noticed that the symbols surrounding Chen Nian subtly resonated with the symbols on the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand—they were forces of the same origin.

'She is suppressing something.' He said quietly, not a question, but a statement."

dialogue.content:
"Yes. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul nodded: She herself is the nemesis of the Heavenly Eye, but what the Holy Sect doesn't know is that she is simultaneously the 'key' to the Tianji Record.

Chen Ji abruptly looked up.

Every time you use the Tianji Record, you consume Heavenly Fate Value, correct? Mo Xiansheng's voice became profound: You think this is the Tianji Record's rule? No—this is a rule set by the Heavenly Eye. The day your Heavenly Fate Value is exhausted is the day you become its piece completely. But if your sister awakens—she can break this shackle.

Chen Ji fell silent.

However, breaking the shackle also means releasing the Heavenly Eye's full power. Mo Xiansheng's voice dropped low: So you now face a choice—save your sister, let her awaken, become the only person who can break the Tianji Record's rules. But doing so might also cause this world to face a Heavenly Eye with no constraints whatsoever."

text.content:
"The vision in the underground palace suddenly shook violently, and the Holy Sect's cultivators accelerated their chanting speed.

Chen Nian's eyelids trembled slightly, as if sensing something. Her lips moved silently, and Chen Ji understood that lip reading—

'Brother.'

Just one word. But Chen Ji felt something violently strike his chest.

He remembered scenes from many years ago: Chen Nian pulling at his clothes and crying while asking for sugar-coated hawthorns; her heartbreaking cries when she was carried away during the Chen family fire; and over these ten years, every time he woke from a dream, the obsession telling himself 'I must find her.'

He never considered himself a good person. After这么多 years navigating the cultivation world, he had long learned to be ruthless. But at this moment, he clearly knew—

Even if the road ahead is a bottomless abyss, even if he must gamble the entire world, he must save Chen Nian."

choice.prompt: "Faced with this truth that could overturn the Three Realms, Chen Ji must make a choice:"

choices.text: "Act immediately, infiltrate the Forbidden Grounds alone"
choices.description: "Time is short, and the Holy Sect's ritual could be completed at any moment. Chen Ji decided to abandon all contingencies, use the Tianji Record's prophetic ability to find the only breakthrough point, and rescue Chen Nian alone."
choices.visible_cost: "Lose all strategic buffer, possibly face the entire Holy Sect's elite directly"
choices.visible_reward: "The fastest chance to rescue Chen Nian, and her possible assistance after awakening"
choices.risk_hint: "Once failed, not only will Chen Nian be completely sealed, but you yourself will fall into an inescapable abyss"
choices.process_label: 陈机眼中闪过一丝决绝

text.content:
"Chen Ji's figure vanished into the night, leaving only a quiet whisper: 'Little Nian, brother is coming for you.'

The Tianji Record Fragment shook violently, as if sensing its master's determination. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed quietly and faded away—he knew the chess game had entered its most dangerous phase.

And at the same time, deep within the Forbidden Grounds, dozens of Holy Sect cultivators opened their eyes simultaneously. Their team leader, an白发苍苍的老者, an elderly man with silver hair, curled his lips into a meaningful smile: 'So he's come? Chen Xuan's successor... the piece of destiny, after all, must fall onto the chessboard.'"

choices.memory_label: 选择了不顾一切的营救之路

choices.description: "Chen Ji would not act rashly. He decided to contact Ye Qing and Su Qingyao, leveraging the Demon Path Saintess's Tianji Record shielding ability and the Tianqing Sect's intelligence network to devise a thorough plan."
choices.visible_cost: "Time is needed to consolidate resources, possibly missing the optimal rescue opportunity"
choices.visible_reward: "Higher probability of success, and potential allied support"
choices.risk_hint: "The Holy Sect's ritual progress will not wait for anyone; every moment of delay makes Chen Nian's situation more dangerous"
choices.process_label: 陈机眼中闪过算计的光芒

text.content:
"Chen Ji quickly retrieved his communication jade talisman, sending rescue signals to both Ye Qing and Su Qingyao.

Less than a quarter of an hour later, two figures appeared before him almost simultaneously. Ye Qing still had that languid appearance, but his eyes carried undeniable gravity: 'I sensed spiritual fluctuations in the Forbidden Grounds—you mean your sister is there?'

Su Qingyao went straight to the point: 'The Tianqing Sect's intelligence network has already detected a large gathering of Holy Sect experts heading toward the Forbidden Grounds. Chen Ji, what exactly did you discover?'

Chen Ji held nothing back, laying out everything the Tianji Record had prophesied. After hearing it all, the two women reacted very differently—Ye Qing curled his lips into an intriguing smile: 'Interesting, the Heavenly Eye's shackle? Seems like our Demon Path will play the savior this time.'

Su Qingyao's brow furrowed: 'This matter is too huge, relying solely on us few...'"

choices.memory_label: 选择了借力打力的策略

choices.text: "First sabotage the Holy Sect's plan, then rescue"
choices.description: "Rescuing directly is the dumbest choice—the Holy Sect is hoping he does exactly that. Chen Ji decided to do the opposite, first throw the Holy Sect's arrangement into chaos, leaving them too occupied to complete the ritual."
choices.visible_cost: "Need to divide attention, possibly be misunderstood by Chen Nian during the operation"
choices.visible_reward: Disrupt the Holy Sect's rhythm to create better conditions for the rescue
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may distrust you because she was 'abandoned'
choices.process_label: 陈机露出一个危险的笑容

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the diagram into his sleeve, and his expression calmed. 'The Holy Sect wants to use me as a chess piece? Then I'll play the part for them.' His voice was soft, but Ye Qing detected the chill in it. 'Aren't they gathering in the Forbidden Grounds? Then I'll let the three major sects know exactly what the Holy Sect is scheming there.' Su Qingyao raised an eyebrow: 'You're going to spread the news?' 'Not spread it—let the three major sects 'coincidentally' discover the Holy Sect's scheme.' Chen Ji sneered. 'The three major sects and the Holy Sect are mortal enemies. They absolutely won't sit by and watch the Holy Sect monopolize the power of the Heavenly Eye. By then, the Holy Sect will be too busy protecting itself to have the energy to complete any ritual.' Ye Qing applauded: 'Brilliant! The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind—you're that oriole.' Chen Ji didn't smile. He only looked toward the Forbidden Grounds: 'But this is only the first step. The second step is still to rescue her.'

choices.memory_label: 选择了先搅局再救人的策略

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, withdrawing the Tianji Record Fragment back into his Mental Sea. No matter which path he chose, one thing remained certain—their reunion would not be a warm sibling reunion, but a high-stakes gamble with fate. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying an unusual warmth: 'Chen Xuan once faced a similar moment. He chose to sacrifice himself to buy an opportunity for those who came after. You were his chosen one. I believe you can forge a different path.' Chen Ji remained silent. He simply stood there, gazing toward the Forbidden Grounds, his eyes deep and unfathomable. Ten years had passed. He had walked through darkness for a decade, carrying the weight of his clan's annihilation, struggling to survive at the very bottom of the cultivation world. He thought his heart had grown cold and hard, thought he had forgotten what it meant to care. But now he realized—the little girl who used to tug at her brother's sleeve, begging for sugar-coated hawthorns, had never truly disappeared from his heart. 'Xiao Nian,' he whispered, his voice as light as a sigh, 'Wait a little longer. I promise I'll get you out.'

dialogue.content: At that moment, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly trembled violently—Chen Nian's foresight vision appeared again, but this time, she opened her eyes. Her gaze seemed to pierce through endless void, looking directly at Chen Ji. 'Brother...' her voice came in fragments, as if disturbed by something, 'Don't...come...this is...' Before she could finish, the vision shattered violently, turning into blinding white light. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—he saw, behind Chen Nian, a massive golden vertical eye, coldly watching him. That vertical eye held no emotion, only endless pressure and scrutiny—as if observing an ant trying to shake a towering tree. The Heavenly Eye. It already knew he was watching it.

text.content: The white light faded. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, cold sweat beading on his forehead. That glance...though merely an illusion within the foresight, he felt as if something had pierced through him. His connection to the Tianji Record seemed to have become even more subtle because of that glance. 'It has noticed you.' Mo Xiansheng's voice came, carrying a hint of gravity. 'From now on, it will be watching every move you make.' Chen Ji slowly stood up, wiping the sweat from his temple. A cold smile actually curved his lips: 'It was always watching. The difference is whether it wanted me to know it was watching.' He rotated his wrist, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes: 'Since it wants to watch a show, I'll perform for it.'

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye is already watching you. Your next move must be made with even greater caution:

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record to divine its weaknesses
choices.description: Since the Heavenly Eye proactively revealed itself, Chen Ji decided to do the opposite—using the Tianji Record to capture every trace of weakness it revealed. Even if it meant expending more Heavenly Fate Value, he would find a way to counter it.

choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence for countering the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: If Heavenly Fate Value drops too low, the Tianji Record may backlash with dire consequences

text.content: Chen Ji bit his fingertip, using blood as the guide, and dripped his essence onto the fragment. The Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with blinding golden light, countless ancient runes manifesting in the void. Chen Ji felt his consciousness suddenly pulled by a force— He saw a chaotic void. In the depths of that void, a massive golden vertical eye coldly watched him. But this time, he saw more: around that vertical eye, countless delicate chains coiled, each chain engraved with densely packed runes. Those runes were exactly the same as the ones on the Tianji Record. 'So that's how it is...' Chen Ji murmured to himself. The Heavenly Eye was not invincible—it too was a bound existence. And the source of those chains seemed intricately connected to the Tianji Record. Just as he wanted to see more clearly, the golden vertical eye suddenly contracted, a world-annihilating pressure bearing down on him—

choices.memory_label: 冒险窥探天道之眼的秘密

choices.text: Temporarily hide and wait for the right moment
choices.description: Since the Heavenly Eye has already noticed him, acting rashly would only alert the enemy. Chen Ji decided to stay put, letting the Holy Sect believe their plan was proceeding smoothly, waiting until the critical moment to strike.
choices.visible_cost: Need to endure inner torment; every moment is excruciating
choices.visible_reward: Better timing for action, and lower risk of exposure
choices.risk_hint: The pain Chen Nian endures during the ritual will continue to intensify
choices.process_label: 陈机强迫自己冷静下来

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, pressing all his emotions deep into his heart. He knew how agonizing this wait would be—knowing his sister was suffering there, knowing the enemy was implementing a world-destroying plan, yet he had to pretend to know nothing. But this was precisely what he excelled at. In the past ten years, he had walked countless times on the edge of cliffs, surviving through this very patience. He could smile at enemies, share drinks with his father's killers, maintain the most humble posture when everyone looked down on him. Because he knew that being alive meant the chance to turn the tables. 'Mo Xiansheng,' he spoke, his voice calm without a trace of波动, 'Tell me, from now until the Forbidden Grounds open, how much time?' Mo Xiansheng pondered for a moment: 'Seven days.' 'Seven days...' Chen Ji opened his eyes, a sharp gleam flickering in his gaze, 'That's enough.'

choices.memory_label: 选择了隐忍等待的策略

choices.text: Proactively confess everything to Su Qingyao
choices.description: Su Qingyao is the only person who has noticed Chen Ji's abnormality. Instead of being passively exposed, it's better to take the initiative and confess honestly—perhaps gaining the Tianqing Sect's support, even if the cost is exposing his biggest secret.
choices.visible_cost: Completely expose the existence of the Tianji Record, losing all pretense
choices.visible_reward: May gain the Tianqing Sect's support, as well as a truly trusting ally
choices.risk_hint: Once Su Qingyao cannot accept it, he will lose all standing in the righteous path
choices.process_label: 陈机做出了一个艰难的决定

text.content: Chen Ji found Su Qingyao and stood before her residence for an entire night. When dawn's light was dim, Su Qingyao opened the door and saw Chen Ji standing outside, drenched in dew. A slight surprise crossed her face. 'I have something to tell you.' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse. 'About who I am, about the Tianji Record, about my sister—about the truth behind all of this.' Su Qingyao was silent for a long time, then stepped aside: 'Come in and speak.' The conversation that day lasted an entire day and night. When Chen Ji finished his final words, the cold expression on Su Qingyao's face was gone, replaced by a complex look. 'You...' she said softly, 'Are even crazier than I imagined.' Chen Ji smiled, that smile carrying a hint of exhaustion: 'So, will you help me?' Su Qingyao didn't answer directly. She stood up, walked to the window, her back to Chen Ji: 'The Tianqing Sect won't mobilize their full strength for an outsider. But—' She turned around, warmth appearing in her eyes: 'I, Su Qingyao, am willing to go mad with you this one time.'

choices.memory_label: 选择向苏青瑶坦白一切

text.content:
Night hung like ink over the world. Chen Ji stood at the apex of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, letting the mountain wind ripple through his robe sleeves.

Behind him, the Tianji Record Fragment glowed faintly as countless pieces of information flowed through his Mental Sea. Seven days—neither long nor short. Enough time for him to prepare, yet also enough for the Holy Sect to complete most of their arrangements.

He closed his eyes and began deducing every subsequent chess move within his mind.

The Forbidden Grounds entrance, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, the Eye of Heavenly Dao, Chen Nian, the Holy Sect, Mo Xiansheng... all the clues intertwined in Chen Ji's thoughts, gradually weaving into an enormous net.

What he wanted was not merely to rescue Chen Nian.

He wanted to break it all—to shatter the Eye of Heavenly Dao's chess game, to break free from the Tianji Record's shackles, to end this millennia-old deadly deadlock.

Even if it meant paying everything for it.

"Eye of Heavenly Dao..." he murmured softly, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips, "Since you want to watch the show, I'll perform a drama you'll never forget."

At that moment, the Tianji Record Fragment vibrated once more.

Chen Ji lowered his gaze to see golden characters emerge on the fragment—those ancient, weathered words seemed to belong to an era long past:

「The key has awakened, the caged bird sings. After seven days, Heavenly Fate shall align.」

He stared at those words for a long while before suddenly letting out a soft laugh.

"Interesting." He spoke to himself, "It seems I'm not the only one laying plans."

He knew that from this moment, all the chess players had entered the game. The Holy Sect, the Eye of Heavenly Dao, Mo Xiansheng, and that Chen Xuan lurking in the shadows... each and every one was waiting for that moment seven days hence.

And he, Chen Ji, would carve out his own path in this grand博弈.

The mountain wind howled as Chen Ji's silhouette appeared lonely and resolute against the night.

Seven days.

Would be enough.

When Chen Ji finally pieced together the complete truth of the Holy Sect's plan, his fingertip stopped at the edge of that blurred foresight vision.

In the vision, Chen Nian was slowly opening her eyes. Her gaze pierced through the layers of Void, as if she could see her brother standing on the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Two clear teardrops slipped from the corners of her eyes, and she silently mouthed three words.

Chen Ji understood.

"Run quickly."

Not "save me," but "run quickly."

Chen Ji's fists clenched abruptly, his knuckles cracking. He knew Chen Nian must have sensed something—felt just how terrifying the existence about to be unleashed truly was.

But...

He raised his head, gazing toward the Forbidden Grounds, his eyes flashing with resolve.

"Silly girl." He said quietly, his voice carrying a hint of helpless laughter, "Your brother has never known what it means to run."

The golden characters on the Tianji Record Fragment slowly faded, replaced by a new prophecy:

「The battle of Heavenly Fate begins beneath one's feet.」

Chen Ji took a deep breath and turned to descend the mountain. He still had much to do—contacting allies, gathering intelligence, laying contingencies...

Seven days later, he would make the entire cultivation world witness one thing:

When the scales of fate tilted in his favor, even Heaven would have to bow its head.
